targetTest: Marketplace help shows the marketplace usage
expected: One usage payload per command (marketplace help and help marketplace as usage-info; a bare marketplace and marketplace bogus as usage-error with their reason) whose usage is the marketplace help block with [--local] on the add, remove, autoupdate, and noautoupdate lines and the list alias note moved under the remove alias note
actual: The same payloads with today's help block: no [--local] on any line, and the list alias note in the old column
semanticAssessment: All four scenarios started Pi and ran their command, then failed only at the result has these fields step. In each, the kind, severity, needs reload, and (for the two usage errors) message rows matched; the one difference is the usage row, which shows today's MARKETPLACE_USAGE literal without [--local] and with the list alias note in the old column. This is the D-01 defect: the marketplace help omits --local on the four verbs that accept it.
